case.amplicon_range_bp: empty site 408 bp / filled site 723 bp (delta 315 bp)
case.caveats: Dimorphic locus. Cited accession (clone RP11-362P24, chromosome 17, 179,026 bp) carries the FILLED allele; expect 723 bp. The 408 bp empty allele is not in this accession. No degenerate bases; no junction-spanning primer. Verified by exact-string in-silico PCR: exactly one product, plus strand, 723 bp, containing the Ye-diagnostic 25-mer and canonical Alu motifs. The paper records this locus's human population diversity as NA (it was not scored polymorphic in the panel), which affects its use as a population marker but not the expected product from this template. Uniqueness checked within the cited accession only. Annealing temperature 55 C.
case.citation: Salem AH, Ray DA, Hedges DJ, Jurka J, Batzer MA. Analysis of the human Alu Ye lineage. BMC Evolutionary Biology 2005;5:18. doi:10.1186/1471-2148-5-18. PMID 15725352; PMCID PMC554112.
case.element: Alu Ye5 (SINE, non-LTR); Alu Ye lineage insertion polymorphism
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
